summary: LATAM Airlines Group S.A. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC, reporting a Material Fact under Chilean securities law. The Board of Directors approved summoning an Extraordinary Shareholders' Meeting on August 3, 2026, to consider a share repurchase program affecting up to 5% of subscribed and paid shares, with a maximum duration of five years. The program aims to acquire shares, with pricing to be set by the Board. The filing is the US equivalent of a material fact notice for a share buyback proposal. Watch for shareholder vote outcome and subsequent open-market acquisition execution.
